subject: Geography
source_note: TIE (2023), Geography Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the structure of the Earth

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between relief, climate and natural vegetation
competences: (a) Describe the major climatic regions of the world (tropical, temperate, polar and sub-tropical)
(b) Describe the relationship between major features of the Earth’s surface, climate, and natural vegetation

objectives.text: (a) Describe the major climatic regions of the world (tropical, temperate, polar and sub-tropical)
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, Group Discussion, Field visit, Graphical and Maps presentation
objectives.resources: Map, graphs, photographs, globe, variety of living organisms, and online materials on the major climatic regions of the world.
objectives.assessment_criteria: The major climatic regions of the World are categorised or classified clearly

objectives.text: (b) Describe the relationship between major features of the Earth’s surface, climate, and natural vegetation
objectives.resources: Maps, photographs, globe and online materials on the relationship between major features of the earth’s surface, climate and natural vegetations
objectives.assessment_criteria: The relationship between major features of the Earth’s surface, climate and natural vegetation are correctly described

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic skills and techniques in Geography

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the basic techniques in land surveying
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of surveying (meaning, types, equipment, methods, and importance)

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of surveying (meaning, types, equipment, methods, and importance)
objectives.resources: Relevant books on land surveying, tape measure/chain, Arrows, plumb bob, cross-staff ranging poles, pegs, notebook, pencil/pen, and relevant ICT tools
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of surveying are correctly explored

objectives.resources: Relevant books on land surveying, tape measure/chain, Arrows, plumb bob, cross-staff ranging poles, pegs, notebook, pencil/pen, and relevant ICT tools
objectives.assessment_criteria: The simple tape/ chain surveying is correctly carried out

sub_topics.title: Carry out a project in Geography
competences: (a) Develop and carry out a simple research project in Geography

objectives.text: (a) Develop and carry out a simple research project in Geography
objectives.resources: Environment, institutions, note books, pen, pencil, key informants, camera/smart-phones, and relevant ICT tools
objectives.assessment_criteria: The research title of each group is correctly prepared A simple research project is effectively conducted in the field by each group
